Theme write-ups

Each theme was researched by a dedicated agent that read the manuscripts' TeX, checked current practice and standards, cloned the target codebases where there was one, and ran small experiments where a number would settle a question.

Catalogue map

All 372 result families, organized two ways: by discipline (the catalogue's own 17 subjects) and by impact channel (where a result could reach practice). Cells count families with a credible channel (tiers T1–T3). Click a cell to filter the family list.
